papers.title: Prevalence of Silent Atherosclerosis across Adult Life
papers.summary: No abstract was available for this study, so no results are reported here. Judging from its title, it estimates how common silent atherosclerosis is across adult life, likely using imaging in adults of different ages. See the full paper in NEJM for the methods and findings.
